how.title: How to reserve
how.step1: Open a card or a lot and add it to your selection.
how.step2: Send your request with your name and email address, without creating an account.
how.step3: The seller confirms availability, then agrees payment and shipping with you.
how.help: A request does not hold the cards: they are reserved once the seller accepts it.

login.title: Sign in
login.forgot_html: Forgot your password, or never chose one? Write to the seller (contact): they will send you a link to choose one.
signup.title: Create an account
signup.help: You do not need an account to reserve: it lets you follow your requests online, once the seller has approved it.
signup.unique_password: Choose a password used only on this site: never reuse one from another site (Pokémon account, Google…).
signup.data_html: Your name, email address and requests are used only to handle your reservations. What is kept, for how long, and how to ask for deletion: your data.
signup.sent: Registration received. The seller approves each account: you can sign in once yours is activated.

profile.data_html: Everything this site keeps about you (account and requests), in a JSON file: download my data. What is kept, and for how long.

profile.deleted: Your account and your data have been deleted.
profile.deleted_unverified: Your account is deleted. Older requests without mailbox proof remain separate: contact the seller to verify or erase them.

viewer.pan: Enlarged photo: use the arrow keys to move it
condition.help: Only confirmed conditions are filtered. “Not specified” includes unconfirmed conditions: check the photos. A lot may contain different conditions.
condition.grades: MT: mint · NM: near mint · EX: excellent · GD: good · LP: lightly played · PL: played · PO: poor. NM/EX remains a separate grade. These descriptions are not an external certification.

install.description: Managing the collection: cards, sales and requests.
install.title: Install the management app
install.intro: Added to the home screen, the management app opens full screen, like an app.
install.done: Installation started. The icon appears on the home screen.
install.installed: The management app is already open as an app.
install.iphone_help: Open this page in Safari, tap Share (the square with an arrow pointing up), then “Add to Home Screen”.
install.android_help: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu, then “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
install.privacy: Prices and customer data are never kept on the phone: without a network, the app only shows a waiting page.
offline.title: Offline
offline.help: The phone has no network. The collection, prices and requests stay on the server: reconnect, then try again.
chat.title: Assistant
chat.note: I read the collection and explain; I write nothing. Actions stay in “Your turn” and on the management screens.
chat.privacy: Your questions, conversation and screen context, and tool results go to Google (Gemini). Do not paste customer data. History: 30 days, nightly purge; flagged exchanges: up to 180 days to improve answers. “Erase” removes those too.
chat.erase_confirm: Erase all your conversations with the assistant?
chat.disabled: The assistant is off: its model key is not configured on the server. The brief and the “Your turn” queue work without it.
chat.interrupted: Incomplete answer: the connection ended before completion.
chat.suggest.sales: How much did I sell this week?
chat.tool.why_not_for_sale: Checking why it is not for sale…
chat.flag.label: Report a wrong or unhelpful answer
chat.flag.note_label: What went wrong with the answer, optional
chat.flag.sent: Thanks: the answer is reported for the test bench.

push.help: The morning brief and new requests, as numbers only: never a customer’s name or address.
push.install_first: On iPhone, first install the app (“Install on the phone” button), then open it from the Home Screen to turn notifications on.
push.unsupported: This browser does not receive the management app’s notifications.
push.server_off: Notifications are not configured on the server yet.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this app: allow them in the phone’s settings.
push.on: Notifications are on for this phone.
push.off: Notifications are off for this phone.
push.error: The notifications could not be changed. Please try again.
valuation.trend.help: TCGdex trend of the recorded variant.
valuation.prudent.help: Lower of the trend and the 30-day average. Both prices are required; no condition discount.
valuation.sale_estimate.help: Latest Cardmarket offers pasted for the current identity, variant and condition. Asking prices, before fees and shipping. A copy without pasted offers has no estimate, even if it has a trend.
